name: gesture_list
description: The hand gestures you know: their names, how to make them and what they do.

name: gesture_teach
description: Learn a new hand gesture by watching. Call this when the user wants to teach you one, and in the same reply tell them to show you three times when the countdown appears above their hand. It answers about 10 seconds later, when the takes are over: then say whether it worked. An error says why; read it out and offer to try again. The gesture is saved and active as soon as this succeeds.

name.description: What to call it, in the user's words (e.g. 'peace sign')

action.description: What it does: none, window.summon (brings the window you point at to you), window.minimize, window.close (closes the window they look at), window.reopen (the last window closed), windows.hide (hides every window), windows.show, albie.perch (you jump into their hand), albie.release, albie.come, display.toggle (the gesture display), or tool:<tool name> to run one of your tools. Default none.

args.description: With tool:<tool name>, the arguments to call the tool with, e.g. {"view": "cad"} for tool:ui_open_view

name: gesture_cancel
description: Stop watching for a gesture being taught. Nothing is saved.

name: gesture_bind
description: Change what an existing gesture does, built-in or taught. Built-in gestures: Bring window, Send window away, Call Albie, Hide all windows, Show all windows, Close window, Reopen window.

name: gesture_forget
description: Forget a taught gesture. Shows the user a confirm card; tell them to tap Yes.

name: gesture_hands
description: The hands setting. left_all (the default): the left hand closing hides every window and opening shows them again, while the right hand's close, open and point-flicks work on one window. right_all swaps the hands. off: no hand hides everything, and either hand works on one window. With no mode, says the current setting.

name: gesture_display
description: Show or hide the display of what the user's hands are doing and every gesture you know.
